slides.text:
5 bizarre life hacks
my colleague taught me

1 — A full glass of water
before every coffee

No water, no coffee

2 — Stairs, but only up

Elevator down
It's about showing up

3 — Lunch without
your phone

You eat less, weirdly

4 — Set a bedtime alarm

Not a wake-up one

slides.heading: 5 — Her weirdest one: SOMA
slides.body: An AI that reads your watch, your sleep, your meals — and quietly plans your day around your body
